01 / ENGINEERING WITH PURPOSE
THE FEDPUMP DIFFERENCE

More than a repair.
A return to performance.

When your pumps stop, your operation feels it. We understand what’s at stake.

Founded by Ermindo da Cunha in 1991, Fedpump is an engineering machine workshop specialising in pump refurbishment. From an individual component to a complete restoration, our team brings the skill, care and practical knowledge your equipment deserves.

Precision workmanship Collaborative service Equipment life extension Dependable delivery
Meet the workshop behind the work

INSIDE FEDPUMP

The right equipment.
The right hands.

From our workshop in Anderbolt, Boksburg, we bring together industrial machinery and generations of practical know-how.

Equipped for the detail.

Vertical and horizontal boring, milling and radial arm drilling. Working with cast iron, stainless steel, bronze and specialised alloys.

Experience, passed on.

Our people are our greatest strength. Hands-on development and skills transfer keep our knowledge growing across generations.
